Match Overview

Newcastle Jets and Kashiwa Reysol meet in the AFC Champions League Elite on 24 November 2026. Kickoff is scheduled for 07:45 UTC. The venue for this fixture has not been officially confirmed at the time of writing. Both clubs are competing in the East region group stage; Kashiwa Reysol currently sit fourth with seven points from four matches, while Newcastle Jets are bottom of the group without a point after four defeats.

Kashiwa Reysol have collected two wins, one draw and one loss, scoring eight goals and conceding three. Newcastle Jets have lost all four group games, conceding 19 goals and scoring six. This match represents an opportunity for Kashiwa Reysol to strengthen their position in the upper half of the table, while Newcastle Jets will be aiming to register their first points of the campaign.

Daejeon Citizen vs Beijing Guoan Live Stream: Kickoff Time, How to Watch & Match Preview

Match Overview

Daejeon Citizen face Beijing Guoan in the AFC Champions League Elite league phase on 24 November 2026. Kickoff is scheduled for 10:00 UTC. The venue has not been officially confirmed for this fixture. Both clubs are competing in the East region of the revamped elite competition, where the top eight teams advance to the round of 16.

After four matchdays, Beijing Guoan sit ninth in the East standings with seven points from two wins, one draw and one loss. Daejeon Citizen occupy tenth place with four points from one win, one draw and two defeats. The visitors have scored ten goals but conceded the same number, while Daejeon have found the net only twice and shipped four. This meeting represents an opportunity for either side to climb toward the qualification places with roughly half the league phase remaining.

A win for the visitors would strengthen their grip on a round-of-16 berth; a home victory would pull Daejeon level on points with their opponents and reignite their qualification hopes. Kyoto Sanga vs Pohang Steelers Live Stream: Kickoff Time, How to Watch & Match Preview

Match Overview

Kyoto Sanga welcome Pohang Steelers to Sanga Stadium by Kyocera on 24 November 2026 for a Matchday 5 fixture in the AFC Champions League Elite East Region league stage. Kickoff is scheduled for 10:00 GMT. Kyoto Sanga currently sit sixth in the table with seven points from four matches, while Pohang Steelers are fifteenth with just one point. The home side have won two and drawn one of their opening four games, conceding only three goals, whereas Pohang have lost three and drawn one, shipping eleven goals. This match represents a clear opportunity for Kyoto to strengthen their position in the top eight while Pohang desperately need a result to keep their knockout-stage hopes alive.
